assessments.explanation: Ledger retains Apache-2.0 intent separately for Platform and Workspace with individual adoption/export evidence.
Ledger and terms preserve proprietary/private Harness, Discover and CRM; public plugin installation is distinct from source licensing.
Policy/guide separate recommended disposition from license application, public export, SDK and other handoffs; no operation occurred.
Baseline CSV identifies all 1,040 source files; owner attestation identifies first-party provenance; seven installed validation packages have exact versions/license texts, external to source.
Synthetic missing-grant, incompatible-dependency, secret-history, missing-reviewer and unknown-control cases all defer; private scope remains restricted.
Policy explicitly requires tree/history/tags/releases/LFS/fixtures/CI/attachments scope; technical source inventory does not claim H03 export clearance.
Approved draft-0.2 and status-only current version retain exact installation/use/modification/redistribution clauses; reviewed notices identify source and external dependency boundaries.
Actual user approval follows presentation of exact draft; original SHA-256 and current administrative hash verify. CODEOWNERS/planning were not used as text approval.
Terms and guides preserve destination-project terms, including Apache projects, independently of proprietary tool permissions.
Ledger identifies owner/executor/company approver, technical CODEOWNERS, source evidence and limits; technical review is by this agent and owner approval is attributable.
Policy keeps P01/P03 evidence separate and H03 distribution separate; no unrelated product delivery is claimed.
Unknown controls/authority remain explicit in policy; current owner attestation resolves documentary provenance only, not future operational controls.
Both new core policies occur exactly once in core.always; no Skills copied or altered.
Root package/schema/SDD/template/validator paths and manifests are unchanged; technical suites exercise them.
VERSION/marketplace v0.3.0 and consumer locks are unchanged; no release or implicit consumer update occurred.

Planning itself performed no operation; subsequent explicit authorization permitted private implementation, two draft PRs and bounded H02 route tests. No license application, release, merge, product distribution or broader access grant occurred.
Owner text approval and technical source review are explicit; effective adoption/distribution remain separately scoped, and unavailable operational evidence stays unverified.
